title: ETL
seoTitle: DataChannel - Extract, Transform & Load (ETL) | Product Features
seoDescription: Use DataChannel's ETL to securely integrate data from all the databases and apps that drive your business instead of manual data downloads, spreadsheets or ad-hoc scripts into a cloud data warehouse

blocks.title: Data when and where you need it
blocks.subtitle: Securely connect to all the databases and apps that drive your business instead of manual data downloads, spreadsheets or ad-hoc scripts

blocks.heading: Hassle free data pipelines from any data source
blocks.body: Extract & load data from SaaS apps, relational databases, cloud storage platforms, REST APIs & more

blocks.heading: Get access to our ever expanding collection of data sources
blocks.body: We have 100+ pre-built integrations for all popular cloud apps and data sources. If you have a specific requirement not covered by our existing list, we will be happy to build the integration for you.

blocks.heading: Connect multiple Data Warehouses
blocks.body: We support all popular cloud data warehouses like Google Bigquery, AWS Redshift, Snowflake & many more. Choose to configure your own warehouse or select a DataChannel managed warehouse. Decide which region your data resides in.

blocks.heading: Pre & post-load data transformations that execute in your data warehouse
blocks.body: Write your data transformations in native SQL and schedule them with DataChannel. Set up dependencies on data pipelines to ensure data freshness and integrity

blocks.heading: Automate your data transfer with reliable, scalable and stable pipelines
